1.t: The hour drew nigh and the moon was rent in twain.

2.t: And if they behold a portent they turn away and say: Prolonged illusion.

3.t: They denied (the Truth) and followed their own lusts. Yet everything will come to a decision

4.t: And surely there hath come unto them news whereof the purport should deter,

5.t: Effective wisdom; but warnings avail not.

6.t: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) on the day when the Summoner summoneth unto a painful thing.

7.t: With downcast eyes, they come forth from the graves as they were locusts spread abroad,

8.t: Hastening toward the summoner; the disbelievers say: This is a hard day.

9.t: The folk of Noah denied before them, yea, they denied Our slave and said: A madman; and he was repulsed.

10.t: So he cried unto his Lord, saying: I am vanquished, so give help.

11.t: Then opened We the gates of heaven with pouring water

12.t: And caused the earth to gush forth springs, so that the waters met for a predestined purpose.

13.t: And We carried him upon a thing of planks and nails,

14.t: That ran (upon the waters) in Our sight, as a reward for him who was rejected.

15.t: And verily We left it as a token; but is there any that remembereth?

16.t: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!

17.t: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?

18.t: (The tribe of) A'ad rejected warnings. Then how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings.

19.t: Lo! We let loose on them a raging wind on a day of constant calamity,

20.t: Sweeping men away as though they were uprooted trunks of palm-trees.

21.t: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!

22.t: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?

24.t: For they said; Is it a mortal man, alone among us, that we are to follow? Then indeed we should fall into error and madness.

25.t: Hath the remembrance been given unto him alone among us? Nay, but he is a rash liar.

26.t: (Unto their warner it was said): To-morrow they will know who is the rash liar.

27.t: Lo! We are sending the she-camel as a test for them; so watch them and have patience;

28.t: And inform them that the water is to be shared between (her and) them. Every drinking will be witnessed.

29.t: But they call their comrade and he took and hamstrung (her).

30.t: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!

31.t: Lo! We sent upon them one Shout, and they became as the dry twigs (rejected by) the builder of a cattle-fold.

32.t: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?

33.t: The folk of Lot rejected warnings.

34.t: Lo! We sent a storm of stones upon them (all) save the family of Lot, whom We rescued in the last watch of the night,

35.t: As grace from Us. Thus We reward him who giveth thanks.

36.t: And he indeed had warned them of Our blow, but they did doubt the warnings.

37.t: They even asked of him his guests for an ill purpose. Then We blinded their eyes (and said): Taste now My punishment after My warnings!

38.t: And in truth the punishment decreed befell them early in the morning.

39.t: Now taste My punishment after My warnings!

40.t: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?

41.t: And warnings came in truth unto the house of Pharaoh

42.t: Who denied Our revelations, every one. Therefore We grasped them with the grasp of the Mighty, the Powerful.

43.t: Are your disbelievers better than those, or have ye some immunity in the scriptures?

44.t: Or say they: We are a host victorious?

45.t: The hosts will all be routed and will turn and flee.

46.t: Nay, but the Hour (of doom) is their appointed tryst, and the Hour will be more wretched and more bitter (than their earthly failure).

47.t: Lo! the guilty are in error and madness.

48.t: On the day when they are dragged into the Fire upon their faces (it is said unto them): Feel the touch of hell.

49.t: Lo! We have created every thing by measure.

50.t: And Our commandment is but one (commandment), as the twinkling of an eye.

51.t: And verily We have destroyed your fellows; but is there any that remembereth?

52.t: And every thing they did is in the scriptures,

53.t: And every small and great thing is recorded.

54.t: Lo! the righteous will dwell among gardens and rivers,

55.t: Firmly established in the favour of a Mighty King.
